summary: Job 1324 stopped at the first restraint-release O-H coverage gate after preserving a converged 17-image restrained snapshot. That snapshot is now the hash-bound round-0 source for a deployed but unsubmitted MatRIS-primary/AQCat25-secondary exact-prediction and VASP-calibration workflow.

payload.objective: Run a real MatRIS-primary/AQCat25-secondary active-learning round for the Fe(110) C2HO* + H* -> C2H2O* TS path, beginning from the immutable job-1324 preconditioning snapshot and its first restraint-release failure boundary.
current_evidence: MZ73 job 1324 ended with producer exit code 1 at 2026-08-26T14:55:25Z; no fully released ML-NEB path was produced.
The restrained preconditioning stage converged and preserved an immutable 17-image snapshot whose geometry gates all passed. It is a restrained diagnostic path, not an MEP and not a Dimer parent.

The first half-strength release failed because required O-H 1.1-1.8 A coverage fell from images 10/11/12 to only 10/11. C-C preservation, O-H monotonicity, periodic continuity, adjacent RMSD, and the 1.0 A maximum single-movable-atom-step gate still passed.
The coverage-loss boundary is accepted only as a round-0 active-learning sampling trigger; threshold relaxation or another unconstrained path resubmission is not authorized.

A hash-bound 17-structure exact prediction batch is deployed to MZ73 with MatRIS checkpoint 1e6a85b33db075ad1637eca7537084024a694b1340358911212d8a5c518c6601 and AQCat25 checkpoint e1f14d50590102dbdf64491a6ae328df6ba0ca2ebb947fbe72213820ae67eb50.
Remote request, all structure hashes, runtime hashes, checkpoint hashes, Python compilation, and shell syntax passed. No GPU prediction job and no VASP job has been submitted.

The work-side chain now supports exact full-force predictions from both models, peak/neighbor/rising/falling/disagreement/anomaly selection, compatible SIGMA=0.20 eV VASP label preparation, and separate MatRIS-VASP/AQCat25-VASP force plus relative-energy assessment. Calibration has not yet occurred.
payload.one_executable_step: After explicit authorization, submit exactly one bounded MZ73 job for the deployed 17-structure exact MatRIS/AQCat25 prediction batch. On completion, collect the hash-bound prediction set, select at most seven informative structures, and prepare but do not submit the compatible VASP force-label batch.
payload.submission_boundary: The job-1324 authorization is consumed. Do not submit the prepared MZ73 exact-prediction batch, VASP labels, fine-tuning, a new ML path, CI-NEB, or Dimer without the applicable reviewed evidence and explicit authority. Model-model disagreement is sampling rank only until independent VASP held-out calibration passes.
done_when: Exact MatRIS and AQCat25 predictions exist for every frozen round-0 structure.
Selected identical structures have accepted VASP single-point energy and complete per-atom force labels on the active SIGMA=0.20 eV branch.
MatRIS-VASP and AQCat25-VASP errors are assessed separately.
If MatRIS fails, an energy-and-force-aware checkpoint is trained with replay, the complete path is rerun, and a disjoint held-out VASP TS set passes before calibration is claimed.
A scientifically reviewed VASP refinement path can then enter the transition-state-search execution gates.
